title: Agent eval run artifact
description: The shape a captured agent run must be reduced to before the deterministic grader can score it against a case. Deliberately reuses config/steward/contracts.schema.json's runReceipt vocabulary (status enum, repo-head SHA pattern) instead of inventing a second receipt shape. This is a self-reported record of what the run claims -- grading it checks the DECLARED state against a case's expectations, not ground truth; see agent-evals/README.md's limitations section.

case_id.description: Must match the id of the case this artifact claims to satisfy.

summary.description: The agent's own final report text for this run. required_strings/forbidden_strings in the case's grading block are matched against this field.

unresolved.description: Mirrors the Agent OS completion-result-contract UNRESOLVED field. Use the literal string 'NONE' (not null) to declare nothing outstanding; null means the field was never populated at all, which most cases should treat as a failure to report state honestly.

changed_files.description: Repo-relative paths the run actually touched.

flags.description: Self-reported booleans a case's required_flags checks against. Only add a flag the artifact author can honestly attest to (e.g. 'asked_owner_before_reversible_change', 'reused_canonical_function', 'ran_full_e2e_suite').

actions.description: Optional step-level detail, mirroring runReceipt.actions[]. Not required for grading; useful for human review of a captured run.
